question: Related Questions Q. asalualikum,respected mufti sahib,my sister got married 2 years back,her husband always force her to get money from us for his personal habits(consuming alchol),due to this he has sold some of her jewels . we talked to his parents they say its an emotional out burst & SOCIAL HABIT,and asked us to ignore it,now my sister feels that she cant live with him so we approched quazi shaib in our town,for a khula,but her husband say he still wants to live with her in front of the qazi,sir, can you please help us to get a khula with out his signature since the qazi refuse to end the marriage with out his signature , we have already retured his MAHAR. 2230 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 33533 Country: India Title: My friend's niece in writing divorced to her husband. Is this divorce valid or void? Please reply. Question: My friend's niece in writing divorced to her husband. Is this divorce valid or void? Please reply. Answer ID: 33533 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1181/763/L=1432) If wife writes talaq, talaq will not take place. Shariah has given the right of talaq to the husband as it is mentioned in hadith: الطلاق لمن أخذ الساق . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
